svg.title: Fall Mandalas — step 4: Grow a new pattern each ring
svg.desc: Add an outer ring with a different repeated pattern: twig, stone, twig, stone, or leaves between pinecones. Build another loop if there is room. Use the materials you have, and stop at any size.

text.font-family: Trebuchet MS, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif
Trebuchet MS, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Try a ring of stones, then twigs or cones.

text.font-family: Trebuchet MS, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif
Trebuchet MS, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif
Trebuchet MS, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Build outward, one ring at a time.
